name: merged-dev-runtime
description: Credential-free Tier-P source installation from one clean merged dev commit, using the real non-editable installer, installed command and immutable reuse (or Bridge serving identity).

config.CR_SOURCE_COMMIT: optional exact commit reachable from fetched dev; defaults to its captured tip
config.CR_SOURCE_PLUGIN: agent-bridge (default), agent-codespaces, agent-containers, agent-mcp, agent-ssh, agent-machines, agent-pull-requests, budget-guidance, agent-worktrees, agent-dispatch, agent-index, agent-logger or agent-vault

stages.title: acquire and pin clean merged dev source
materialize source and run the real installer
verify completed source-qualified runtime and installed command
invoke the runtime with the source checkout unavailable
verify immutable reuse and actual runtime use
